# E0204: two version files declare the same version

A version has one file. Two files at the same path, `history/0.0.thema`, can
only reach the compiler through its API, as in a playground request, and
would be two schemas for one version.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0204]: history/0.0.thema and history/0.0.thema both declare version 0.0
 --> ship/history/0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  | ------ the other is here
  |
  = help: a version has one file, under history/
```
